overall.definition: bytes that are classified AND represented as source, editable data or explained generated padding; 100 % only when this equals 1,048,576 and every metric is 100 %
overall.note: documented exceptions are rebuilt exactly and listed with bounds and reason (assets/exceptions.json) but are NOT counted as decompiled, because their meaning is not established

executable_code_classification.definition: code-bank bytes classified as traced code, dead code, jump table, code data or padding
executable_code_classification.remaining: 8 bytes not classified: 0 in code_unreached ranges, 86 in documented exceptions (unread byte groups of unknown purpose, exact bounds in docs/address_map.json)
executable_code_classification.note: no instruction executed outside bank 4 in any emulator run

routine_documentation.definition: entry points with a hand-written or reviewed (high/medium confidence) description; unreferenced (dead) routines count when the reviewed bank-4 classification describes them
routine_documentation.remaining: 0 role-only/low-confidence, 0 generic, 0 dead-code routines without a behaviour description; reviewed entries are spot-checked, not individually re-verified

data_classification.definition: data bytes whose class (asset, tiles, table, padding) is established by code or decoding
data_classification.remaining: 0 unknown bytes + 0 zero-run bytes of unestablished meaning + 78 bytes in documented exceptions (assets/exceptions.json)

data_decoding_editable.definition: data bytes rebuilt from an editable decoded representation (PNG etc.) or generated FFh padding
data_decoding_editable.remaining: 78 opaque bytes (gamedata/raw; all listed in assets/exceptions.json) + 0 generated zero-run bytes not yet explained

runtime_coverage.definition: NATURAL runtime coverage: live instructions executed in at least one run driven only by controller input (no poke/orpoke/forcestate; SRAM only from natural runs), replayed from power-on with emu/ktrun
runtime_coverage.dead_instructions: 1357 unreferenced instructions excluded from the denominator; executed in any run: 0

natural_state_coverage.definition: game states 0-19 dispatched in natural runs, out of the 18 states the code can enter (14 and 15 are never written by any instruction: statically unreachable)

documentation_verification.definition: routines whose description passes the static cross-check AND every RAM address it names was accessed by the routine (or its callees) in a natural run (docs/verification.md); other levels listed in breakdown

reproducible_source_build.definition: share of ROM bytes rebuilt without the original ROM (committed source + gamedata/)
reproducible_source_build.note: source = committed asm; editable = gamedata PNG etc.; generated = layout metadata; opaque = gamedata/raw copies of undecoded bytes.  Only source, editable and explained generated bytes count as decompiled.

status.rom_free_build: VERIFIED (clean build with the ROM removed matches)

definitions:
docs/completion.json - measured progress, computed only from project artifacts.

Six headline metrics (each with an explicit numerator / denominator):
  1 executable_code_classification   code-bank bytes with an evidence-backed class / 65,536
  2 routine_documentation            entry points documented (hand or reviewed high/medium) / all
  3 data_classification              data bytes with an evidence-backed class / data bytes
  4 data_decoding_editable           data bytes decoded into an editable representation, or
                                     generated FFh padding / data bytes   (opaque tables do NOT count)
  5 runtime_coverage                 static instructions executed in the emulator / static instructions
  6 reproducible_source_build        ROM bytes rebuilt without the ROM, split by representation
'Data bytes' = the ROM minus the code bank (40000h-4FFFFh) and the 16-byte footer.
100 % is only claimed for a metric when the numerator equals the denominator.
